evidence: The Al2O3 films were prepared in a SUNALE TM R150 ALD reactor manufactured by Picosun. It was a showerhead-type reactor where the reactant gases enter the reaction space from above the substrate. A deposition process of 5000 cycles resulted in a film whose thickness was 473 nm. Each reaction cycle consisted of a trimethylaluminium pulse, nitrogen purge, a water pulse, and another nitrogen purge.
